reason: No proposal concerns imports between route modules. Grep finds about 35 of 150 route modules importing another route module (e.g. many import _require_admin from routes/auth.py).
No proposal concerns async handlers. All ~1108 @router-decorated handlers found are async def.
No proposal concerns blocking I/O. Some handlers still do synchronous read_text/write_text/open calls (coding.py, observatory.py, admin_prompts.py), but most I/O is awaited or sent through to_thread.
No proposal concerns atomic_io. State writes go through atomic_write_text/bytes in about 19 files. A few renames remain (desktop_rebuild staged.rename, rkllamacpp_installer os.replace(part, dest)).

No proposal concerns key-material creation. secrets.py and hub/identity.py use atomic_create_bytes, but agent_registry_store.py creates the registry Ed25519 PEM key with atomic_write_bytes under a FileLock.

No proposal concerns to_thread wrapping. Direct atomic_write calls sit in sync helpers, but some of those helpers are called directly from async handlers (routes/auth.py _write_power_request, routes/chat_files.py _save_registry).
No proposal concerns templates or SPA placement. tinyagentos/templates holds only agent_debugger.html, and no TemplateResponse or Jinja2Templates usage was found.
No proposal concerns ARIA labels. desktop/src has about 1626 aria-label uses against 943 <button> elements, so icon-only controls are broadly labelled.
No proposal concerns where API calls live. About 109 of 337 component .tsx files under apps/ and components/ call fetch/taosFetch inline.
No proposal concerns pytest or fixtures. There are no unittest.TestCase tests, but about 91 test files call create_app() themselves rather than using the shared app/client fixtures.
No proposal concerns test file naming (D-e4696a is about desktop hook tests). Of 149 route modules, 116 have tests/test_routes_<mod>.py, 17 use plain test_<mod>.py and 16 have neither.
No proposal concerns live refresh or animation. Only about 12 files use useRefreshOnFocus and about 8 use the event-stream hooks, across 51+ app surfaces.
No proposal concerns guard markers. @pytest.mark.guards appears in only 2 test files, one of which is the checker's own test.
No proposal concerns store access. 144 route files use app.state, but about 20 import from *_store modules directly (council.py imports MemberStore; agents.py imports AgentBudgetStore).
No proposal covers app-catalog. 121 of 275 manifests lack at least one required field: requires is missing in 119, install in 120, license in 9 and homepage in 3.
No proposal covers catalog layout. All 275 manifests sit at <category>/<dir>/manifest.yaml, and 263 have a directory name equal to their id.
No proposal covers catalog.yaml. It has 134 entries, and 143 of 275 manifest ids have no matching entry.
No proposal concerns dependencies. pyproject pins python-slugify without the unidecode extra, and nothing in tinyagentos imports unidecode.
No proposal concerns auth guards. A global auth middleware with explicit EXEMPT_PATHS and agent allowlists, plus router-wide CSRF on 147 of 148 includes, gates endpoints.
No proposal concerns negative auth tests. Only about 49 of 138 test_routes_*.py files assert a 401/403 status.

No proposal concerns ownership checks. projects.py uses the house guard with a masked 404 (10 sites, plus 37 _get_owned_project uses), but bare 403s remain in project_files.py, project_canvas.py and project_invites.py.
No proposal concerns envelope binding. peer.py checks both from == authenticated contact and to == local identity in each handler.
No proposal concerns secrets storage. SecretsStore is widely used, but AppConfig still carries wallhaven_api_key, which is serialized to config.
No proposal concerns token hashing. Some stores hash (litellm_keystore token_hash, auth.py), but agent_tokens_store.py stores agent tokens in a plaintext token column.
No proposal concerns [0] indexing. Without semantic analysis it is not possible to tell which [0] uses index a multi-element lookup.
No proposal concerns UTC timestamps. There are 55 timezone-aware datetime.now(...) calls and only one naive datetime.now() (routes/auth.py:9851).
No proposal concerns ISO parsing. Only 2 of 17 fromisoformat call sites normalize a trailing Z first.
No proposal concerns error swallowing. About 56 empty catch blocks out of ~938 in desktop/src and about 265 except...pass out of ~2227 excepts in tinyagentos.
No proposal concerns placeholder arguments. Telling placeholder values from legitimate empty values needs semantic review.
